title: Data units
text:
Data units

Data details supported by 
UNICEDE
/2.

Data units are used for all numerical values.

| Units | Description |
| --- | --- |
| 1: 1.0 | If sums-insured values are in dollars |
| 2: 1000.0 | If sums-insured values are in thousands of dollars |
| 3: 1000000.0 | If sums-insured values are in millions of dollars |
| 4: 1000000000.0 | If sums-insured values are in billions of dollars |

 Note that all of the text after and including the colon (":") is ignored as comments.
